SELECT DISTINCT
    'Glamping Pod' AS accommodation_type,
    gp.pod AS number,
    at_typename.typename AS type
FROM
    glampingpod gp
JOIN
    location l ON gp.locationid = l.id
JOIN
    accommodationtype at_typename ON gp.accommodationtypeid = at_typename.id
WHERE
    LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%snowdonia%'

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
    'Tree House' AS accommodation_type,
    th.house AS number,
    at_typename.typename AS type
FROM
    treehouse th
JOIN
    location l ON th.locationid = l.id
JOIN
    accommodationtype at_typename ON th.accommodationtypeid = at_typename.id
WHERE
    LOWER(l.name) LIKE '%snowdonia%';

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN gp."id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Glamping Pod ' || gp."pod"
        WHEN th."id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Tree House ' || th."house"
    END AS accommodation,
    l."name" AS location
FROM
    "location" l
LEFT JOIN
    "glampingpod" gp ON l."id" = gp."locationid"
LEFT JOIN
    "treehouse" th ON l."id" = th."locationid"
WHERE
    LOWER(l."name") LIKE '%snowdonia%';

WITH new_york_city AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "city"
    WHERE "name" = 'New York'
),
new_york_hotels AS (
    SELECT "id", "name"
    FROM "hotel"
    WHERE "city_id" = (SELECT "id" FROM new_york_city)
),
desired_features AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "leisurefeature"
    WHERE LOWER("feature") IN ('swimming pool', 'hot tub')
)
SELECT DISTINCT h."name" AS "hotel_name"
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON h."id" = rt."hotel_id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
WHERE h."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM new_york_hotels)
  AND lf."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM desired_features);

WITH applicant_projects AS (
    SELECT
        "applicant_id",
        SUM("number_of_completed_projects") AS total_projects
    FROM
        "experiences"
    GROUP BY
        "applicant_id"
),
min_projects_applicant AS (
    SELECT
        "applicant_id"
    FROM
        applicant_projects
    ORDER BY
        total_projects ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    a."name",
    a."phone"
FROM
    "applicants" a
JOIN
    min_projects_applicant mpa ON a."id" = mpa."applicant_id";

    FROM "experiences"
